notes.title: Looking for Imago - v0.11.0
notes.content:
Hey! I'm glad to finally share with you a new version full of improvements :)

Here is the list of the notable changes brought by this version:

[h1]🔥 Hot[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added user authentication through Steamworks
[*] Added Steam Input support
[*] Added community maps browser categories: “Recently updated”, “Trending” & “Most liked”
[*] Added several juicy & visual effects when interacting with game entities like bouncing, squeezing & shaking
[/list]

[h1]🧩 Puzzle levels[/h1]
[list]
[*] Puzzle Levels: Improved few levels
[/list]

[h1]🔨 Level editor[/h1]
[list]
[*] Level Editor: Improved default level
[*] Level Editor: Improved level validation errors presentation for better readability
[*] Level Editor: Fixed native resolution rendering quality for contents scale factor different than 1.0
[*] Level Editor: Added parallaxes in thumbnails
[/list]

[h1]🎨 Rendering / graphics[/h1]
[list]
[*] User Game Options: Changed default texture smoothing option to "bilinear"
[/list]

[h1]🎚️ User interface[/h1]
[list]
[*] Achievement Box & Rich Alert Panel: Improved letters spacing & text generation
[*] Main Menu: Reduced community maps widget attractivity when failing to load maps
[*] Map Thumbnail: Made sure that the large preview is staying on-screen
[*] UI: Improved error font color in few places
[*] Level Selection Screen: Added level title label
[*] Main Menu: Added game info popup that can be shown by clicking the version label several times
[*] Time Attack Level Entry: Fixed inconsistent entries size
[*] UI Navigation: Improved a bit navigation when a Slider is focused
[/list]

[h1]🌐 Network[/h1]
[list]
[*] Network: Implemented token refreshment mechanism
[*] Network: Improved errors management by trying to use response content
[*] Network: Updated end points following API changes on the server side
[*] Network: Improved connection error handling
[/list]

---

See you around!
Aurélien

notes.title: Looking for Imago - v0.10.0
notes.content:
Hey! I'm glad to finally share with you a new version full of improvements :)

Here is the list of the notable changes brought by this version:

[h1]🔥 Hot[/h1]
[list]
[*] Grounds: Fine tuned many levels with the introduction of ground polygon shapes!
[*] Rendering: Added camera space post effects (displacement effect & rendering quality)
[*] Rendering: Added screen space post effects (brightness adjustment & rendering quality)
[*] Rendering: Improved management of particles that cover the entire screen
[*] Main Menu: Integrated the new pines forest illustration
[*] Options Screen: Revamped the options screen with sections
[*] Options Screen: Added game slots selection & management
[*] Optimization: Improved performance on high resolution computers by introducing the rendering quality option
[/list]
[h1]🏃‍♂️ Gameplay & controls[/h1]
[list]
[*] Player: Added early jump canceling when player is upside down while riding entity or pressing down at jump initialization
[*] Parallax Decoration: Added hover player alpha property to better handle alpha transitions when the player is behind a decoration
[*] One Side Platform: Generalized the pass through allowance & logic to allow steep one way platforms
[/list]
[h1]🧩 Puzzle levels[/h1]
[list]
[*] Puzzle Levels: Improved pretty much all levels
[*] Puzzle Levels: Replaced all back ground tiles by ground polygons
[*] Puzzle Levels: Adjusted all parallax decorations with proper hover player alpha
[*] Hint Plant: Fixed missing icon in the mushroom introduction level
[/list]
[h1]🎛️ Game engine[/h1]
[list]
[*] Levels Controller: Improved context recovery after a level loading failure
[*] Ground Generation: Added ground edge tiles caching mechanism
[*] Tiled Level: Fixed reactivation of the spatial deactivator after level reset
[/list]
[h1]🎨 Rendering / graphics[/h1]
[list]
[*] Rendering: Added camera space post effects (displacement effect & rendering quality)
[*] Rendering: Added screen space post effects (brightness adjustment & rendering quality)
[*] Imago Orb: Added attraction aura (surrounding displacement effect)
[*] Imago Portal: Added light refraction effect (through displacement effect)
[*] Dandelion Pappus: Improved visuals by adding a front skin
[*] Trunk Pipe: Improved visuals
[*] Seeds: Improved coffee bean visuals
[*] Screens: Added blur effect on background game to ease screen reading
[*] Rendering: Enabled asynchronous texture upload (on Windows only)
[*] Resources: Ignored Stage 3D resource limits to fix resource allocation issues with high textures scale
[*] Full Screen Particles: Add smooth capacity reduction to prevent particles to sometimes instantly disappear
[*] Spring Meadow Environment: Moved pollen particles in front parallax
[*] Particles Parallax Layers: Improved particles initial population at level startup
[*] Pollen Parallax Layer: Improved a bit emission surface to anticipate default camera movement direction
[/list]
[h1]🎚️ User interface[/h1]
[list]
[*] Options Screen: Improved the screen with sections
[*] UI: Unified all texts styles
[*] UI Navigation: Improved navigation management
[*] UI: Added small text button without background style for very discrete buttons
[*] UI: Added icons to all message box buttons
[*] UI: Improved button icon size management & improve native resolution management
[*] UI Theme: Improved few aspects of the theme in native resolution
[*] Gamepad Controls Popup: Added icon to the configure button
[*] Advanced Button: Improved juggler management
[*] Lockable Item Button: Improved unlocking state change to allow faster interaction with the unlocked item (mostly for the World Selection Screen)
[*] Lockable Item Button: Improved unlocking conditions
[*] UI Navigation Manager: Improved slider value change logic
[/list]
[h1]🔨 Level editor[/h1]
[list]
[*] Level Editor: Added ground polygons edition tools
[*] Level Editor: Improved resources limit / entity wrapper creation error handling
[*] Level Editor: Improved run & publishing validations
[*] Level Editor: Added map cloning capability
[*] Level Editor: Improved update of surrounding entities when updating / deleting an entity
[*] Level Editor: Fixed save buttons state when coming back from a run with unsaved changes
[*] Level Editor: Fixed user maps folder initial setup
[*] Entity Tool Panel: Re-organized entities order & availability
[/list]
[h1]🗃️ Data[/h1]
[list]
[*] Game Slots: Added game slots selection & management from the Options Screen
[*] Game Slots: Improved robustness of game slot completion ratio computation
[*] Run Service: Fixed crash by limiting the number of concurrent uploads of pending runs
[/list]
[h1]🗣️ Texts & translations[/h1]
[list]
[*] Credits: Improved end game quote & animations
[*] Credits: Updated credits list
[/list]

---

I hope you will enjoy it :P

Best,
Aurélien

notes.title: Looking for Imago - v0.9.0 Beta.5!
notes.content:
A new beta is now available :)

Here is the list of the visible changes brought by this new beta:

[h1]Hot[/h1]
[list]
[*] Game: Introduced collectable seeds
[*] Game: Added community maps sharing capability
[*] Rendering: Added ground inner overlay effect to emphasis ground borders and improve visuals
[*] Level Editor: Many improvements brought to the editor
[/list]
[h1]Gameplay & controls[/h1]
[list]
[*] Spikes: Relaxed kill criteria when riding an entity to prevent the player from being killed while riding ants in spiky corners
[*] Climbable entities: Generalized climbing detection when the player is grounded
[*] Hint Plant: Added ability to skip callout message characters addition animation to show the full text faster
[*] Trunk Pipe: Added missing case where the player can get piped with the ridden entity
[/list]
[h1]Rendering / graphics[/h1]
[list]
[*] Render Panel: Added ground inner overlay effect to emphasis ground borders and improve visuals
[*] Rope: Fixed ivy color generation
[*] Pines Forest Environment: Improved rope ivy color
[*] Parallax Decoration: Improved culling logic to be based on the camera view rather than the entire view-port
[*] Hint Plant: Reduced draw calls by removing unnecessary glow filters when not needed
[/list]
[h1]User interface[/h1]
[list]
[*] Pause Overlay: Re-organized buttons order & improved separations
[*] Pause Overlay: Prevented the pause input button to trigger UI buttons since it should be used to resume the game only
[*] Company Screen: Fixed aliased logo
[*] Options Screen: Fixed volume sliders initialization
[*] Screens Manager: Improved fallback screen when failing to load a level
[*] UI: Added more icons on buttons
[*] UI: Improved popups structure to make them more responsive
[*] UI: Unified min width for all text buttons
[*] Achievements: Moved level editor package achievement checks outside of the puzzle end level
[*] Credits Screen: Updated credits
[/list]
[h1]Puzzle levels[/h1]
[list]
[*] Level Management: Added level reset capability for faster level reloads
[*] Puzzle Levels: Improved many levels & add hidden seeds
[/list]
[h1]Level editor[/h1]
[list]
[*] Level Editor: Translated the entire editor
[*] Level Editor: Improved top bar, tool buttons look & textures management
[*] Level Editor: Fixed entity wrappers copy/paste from one level to another
[*] Level Editor: Added basic resource limitation to prevent user from creating too large levels
[*] Level Editor: Optimized tile skins management
[*] Level Editor: Deactivated particles/god rays parallax layers for performance & readability reasons
[*] Level Editor: Removed glow filter on selected tiles layer for performance & quality reasons
[*] Level Editor: Added duplicate shortcut for both selected entities & selected tiles
[*] Level Editor: Fixed level bounds computation
[*] Level Editor: Generalized the file export to simple object into a JSON string serializer
[*] Level Editor: Removed useless level JSON serializations & deserializations
[*] Level Editor: Improved ground tile skin animation in certain situations
[*] Level Editor: Added missing confirmation dialogs when discarding unsaved changes
[*] Level Editor: Fixed active layer label alpha after entity dragging from entity tool panel
[*] Level Editor: Added user profile information in a dedicated inspector accessible from the top tool bar
[/list]
[h1]Texts & translations[/h1]
[list]
[*] i18n: Added initial German language support (beta)
[*] i18n: Unified & improved all texts about lost insects
[*] i18n: Improved various texts
[/list]

---

I hope you will enjoy it :P

Best,
Aurélien
